designChallenges.description: A national AI hackathon engaging undergraduates to build real-world AI solutions, guided by industry experts and evaluated by leading practitioners.
A national-level design competition encouraging undergraduates to innovate in circuit design through creative, real-world electronic solutions.
An open-ended innovation challenge empowering school students and undergraduates to design impactful Arduino-based solutions for real-world problems.
A platform for innovative robotics solutions addressing real-world challenges in automation, industry, and community impact.
A biomedical innovation challenge focused on intelligent healthcare solutions using ECG and physiological signal processing.
A technology-driven challenge exploring next-generation communication systems, including 5G, IoT connectivity, and secure networks.
Sri Lanka’s national gateway to the International Microelectronics Olympiad, identifying top talent in IC design, microelectronics, and chip technologies.
